gloss: on northern border of Canaan, with
definition: [ צְדָד ] proper name, of a location on northern border of Canaan, with ה locative, צְדָ֫דָה Num 34:8 ( Σαραδακ , Samaritan צרדה ), Ezek 47:15 ( Σελδαμμα ), read probably צְרָ֫דָה ; perhaps Khirbet ‚era-da- , north of Abil, east of Merj 'Ajûn toward Hermon (latitude approximatly 33° 25' north, longitude approximately 35° 35' east), so van Kasteren Rev. Bibl., 1895, 30, compare Buhl Geogr. 67 .
